scope: Static review only of the repaired 6868-byte method. This closes the two method findings in the bound original quality report without changing that report or granting content approval. The archived initial method remains history.

findings.evidence: Before S.mkdir/copy/import/apply, the repaired method verifies all proposal source_bindings, both selected-snapshot digests, and all five source-copy hashes against execution admission inputs, in addition to exact proposal/module/factual/prospective-review hashes.

Postcondition checks now run inside a separate try/except. Candidate hash/path/counts/node deltas are recorded before exact-delta assertions. An exception is stored as postcondition_failure, a structured SUPPORTED_ISOLATED_HOLD result is written, and the process exits1. Generated candidate bytes and transaction log remain available for inspection.

All five A transaction paths and the G/V/P mirror locations target the unique task scratch directory. The observer calls the original validator and returns its errors unchanged. A.apply still owns validation/rollback; no check or threshold is suppressed. Exact success postconditions require only drapel and untdelemn appended to the two named existing nodes, no other node changes, identical9473edge and180terminal records, and unchanged pack mirrors.

Transaction stdout/stderr now stream to a line-buffered disk log. SIGTERM raises through the active supported transaction so its existing rollback can run; finally attempts the structured result. This is not a guarantee against SIGKILL, severe memory exhaustion or filesystem failure.

execution_conditions: A fresh separate execution admission must bind this exact repaired method, the reviewed proposal/module/review/snapshot/source set and the five source-copy hashes. The existing outer bounded runner must enforce group RSS, disk increment, deadline and host floors; inner RLIMIT_AS alone is insufficient.

Run only against the declared task scratch copies using the documented reference interpreter and original supported transaction. Preserve a failed attempt; never overwrite it or turn generated bytes from a held attempt into approval.

Treat only an actual zero-exit SUPPORTED_ISOLATED_APPLY_GREEN receipt with exact candidate hashes and unchanged installed source copies as successful materialization. All-game/terminal/fuzzy/history and prospective ordinary HTTP evidence, current native rails and final independent quality acceptance remain pending.
limits: No execution, preflight, build, test, new source research, baseline rerun, fixture/runtime/pool change or install judgment. Materialization success alone cannot establish player benefit, unchanged game profiles or adoption acceptance.
valid_until: Any bound method/proposal/module/review/source change or execution evidence contradicting the reviewed assumptions; repeat affected exact review.
